description: This file defines the 'ClinicalAgent' class responsible for generating medical guideline-based suggestions for diagnostics and supportive care, based on user queries and retrieved guideline snippets. It includes heuristic methods for extracting test recommendations and medicines, leveraging a vector store for relevant guideline retrieval, and provides structured suggestions with reasoning and disclaimers.

classes.name: ClinicalAgent
classes.description: Provides medical guideline-based diagnostic and treatment suggestions, with emphasis on safety, relevant testing, and supportive care, always appending a medical disclaimer.

methods.name: List[str] _extract_tests(self, user_query: str, retrieved_texts: List[str])
methods.description: Heuristically extracts suggested diagnostic tests based on user symptoms and guideline context, gated by red-flag patterns.

methods.name: List[str] _extract_medicines(self, user_query: str, retrieved_texts: List[str])
methods.description: Heuristically extracts suggested over-the-counter medicines or supportive care items based on user query and retrieved guideline snippets.

methods.name: List[Tuple[str,str,float]] _rag(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3)
methods.description: Performs retrieval of guideline snippets related to the user query from the vector store.

methods.name: List[str] _dedupe(self, items: List[str])
methods.description: Removes duplicate items from a list of strings.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[str]] suggest(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3)
methods.description: Produces structured diagnostic and supportive suggestions with contextual notes and disclaimers.

methods.name: List[str] recommend(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3)
methods.description: Provides a flattened list of suggestions suitable for front-end display, including a strong disclaimer.
